title: Agent-Orchestration service registry
description: Optional. Drop this file (as agent-orchestration.config.json) at your repos root to declare the services you work with and where their repos live locally. If absent, Agent-Orchestration discovers services by indexing.

reposRoot.description: Base directory for relative service paths, resolved relative to this config file's location.

services.description: Registry of all services you work with. Each /ship run picks the subset a feature touches.

name.description: Unique service id used on the pipeline bus and in plan.json service tags.

path.description: Local directory of the service repo (relative to reposRoot, or absolute). Defaults to name.

test.description: Shell command to run this service's tests, executed inside its directory (e.g. 'npm test', 'pytest -q', 'mvn -q test').

build.description: Shell command to build this service, executed inside its directory.

dependsOnServices.description: Other service names that must reach done before this one enters a coder batch (dependency waves).
